insight: Founded in 2021 in Karlsruhe, Germany; backed by investors including Intel Ignite, Seedcamp, and Eurazeo.
name: AskUI
tagline: Vision-based agents that automate any UI across desktop, mobile, and web.
description: AskUI builds and deploys computer-use agents that visually detect and operate on-screen elements across operating systems — desktop, mobile, web, embedded, and automotive HMIs — without relying on selectors or accessibility trees. Its AgentOS runtime and Python SDK let teams automate UI testing and workflows and route between models like Claude, Gemini, and OpenAI. It is aimed at enterprise automation and QA.

modelSupport.notes: Routes between Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, and custom providers; no lock-in.

edge: Detects UI elements purely by vision — no selectors or accessibility trees — so the same agents run across desktop, mobile, web, and embedded screens.
pros: Python SDK for automation and QA
